mapper.select: SELECT b.*,b.owner_id=CAST(#{owner} AS uuid) AS editable, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_document d WHERE d.kb_id=b.id AND d.status!='deleted') AS documents FROM knowledge_base b WHERE ORDER BY b.created_at DESC,b.id LIMIT 200
SELECT b.*,b.owner_id=CAST(#{owner} AS uuid) AS editable FROM knowledge_base b WHERE b.id=CAST(#{kb} AS uuid) AND FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base(id,owner_id,name,description,visibility) VALUES(CAST(#{kb} AS uuid),CAST(#{owner} AS uuid),#{name},#{description},#{visibility})
INSERT INTO knowledge_document(id,kb_id,name,content,embedding_space) VALUES(CAST(#{document} AS uuid),CAST(#{kb} AS uuid),#{name},#{content},#{space})
mapper.select: SELECT id,kb_id,name,status,chunk_count,embedding_space,error_message,created_at,updated_at FROM knowledge_document WHERE kb_id=CAST(#{kb} AS uuid) AND status!='deleted' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM knowledge_document WHERE id=CAST(#{document} AS uuid) AND kb_id=CAST(#{kb} AS uuid) AND status!='deleted' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status=CASE WHEN status='delete_failed' THEN 'deleting' ELSE 'pending' END,error_message=NULL,attempts=0, claim=NULL,leased_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=CAST(#{document} AS uuid) AND status IN ('failed','delete_failed')
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status='deleting',claim=NULL,attempts=0,leased_until=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=CAST(#{document} AS uuid)
mapper.select: UPDATE knowledge_document SET claim=CAST(#{claim} AS uuid),attempts=attempts+1, leased_until=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '15 minutes', status=CASE WHEN status='deleting' THEN 'deleting' ELSE 'processing' END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM knowledge_document WHERE status='pending' OR (status='deleting' AND (leased_until IS NULL OR leased_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) OR (status='processing' AND leased_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY updated_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING *
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk(id,document_id,ordinal,content) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),CAST(#{document} AS uuid),#{ordinal},#{content}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE document_id=CAST(#{document} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status=#{status},error_message=#{error},chunk_count=#{count}, leased_until=NULL,claim=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, content=CASE WHEN #{status}='deleted' THEN '' ELSE content END WHERE id=CAST(#{document} AS uuid) AND claim=CAST(#{claim} AS uuid) AND leased_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.ordinal,c.content,d.id AS document_id,d.name AS document_name, b.id AS kb_id,b.name AS kb_name FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id=c.document_id JOIN knowledge_base b ON b.id=d.kb_id WHERE c.id IN CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND d.status='ready' AND d.embedding_space=#{space} AND AND b.id IN CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document WHERE status='ready' AND embedding_space=#{space} AND kb_id IN CAST(#{id} AS uuid))
SELECT b.* FROM agent_knowledge_base a JOIN knowledge_base b ON b.id=a.kb_id WHERE a.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) AND ORDER BY b.name,b.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_knowledge_base WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_knowledge_base(agent_id,kb_id) VALUES(CAST(#{agent} AS uuid),CAST(#{kb} AS uuid))
